question: Is it possible to convert a cloze-style questions to a naturally-looking questions?
title: Simple and Effective Semi-Supervised Question Answering
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents discuss the generation and use of cloze-style questions for pre-training QA models, but none address the possibility of converting cloze-style questions into naturally-looking questions. The focus is on cloze generation, pre-training, and performance, not on transforming cloze questions into natural ones.
